values.en:
Terminology for basics. The Pointer opens the complete registration module. Native declaration names and full argument indices are preserved; named `english` styles extend, rather than replace, existing upstream defaults.

| Lean constant | Style | Display template |
|---|---|---|
| `OfNat.ofNat` | `default` | `#1` |
| `Int` | `default` | `\mathbb{Z}` |
| `Rat` | `default` | `\mathbb{Q}` |
| `Bool` | `default` | `\mathsf{Bool}` |
| `Prod` | `default` | `#0 \times #1` |
| `Sum` | `default` | `#0 \sqcup #1` |
| `Fin` | `default` | `[#0]` |
| `Fin` | `english` | `The type of natural numbers less than #0` |

`[n]` is the zero-based type `Fin n`; `[0]` is empty. Products and disjoint sums of types preserve parenthesization.
values.zh-CN:
基础内容的 Lean 术语宏。Pointer 指向完整的注册模块。沿用原生声明名称及完整参数索引；命名为 `english` 的 Style 是对已有默认 Style 的补充，而非替换。

| Lean constant | Style | Display template |
|---|---|---|
| `OfNat.ofNat` | `default` | `#1` |
| `Int` | `default` | `\mathbb{Z}` |
| `Rat` | `default` | `\mathbb{Q}` |
| `Bool` | `default` | `\mathsf{Bool}` |
| `Prod` | `default` | `#0 \times #1` |
| `Sum` | `default` | `#0 \sqcup #1` |
| `Fin` | `default` | `[#0]` |
| `Fin` | `english` | `The type of natural numbers less than #0` |

`[n]` 表示从零开始编号的 `Fin n`；`[0]` 为空。类型的积与不交和保留括号分组。
